content.value_statement: Paid teams need ad copy that matches the offer, audience, and landing page. This skill creates structured RSA assets, hooks, and angle matrices that are ready for review.
actual_capabilities: Generates RSA headlines and descriptions within stated format limits.
Builds angle matrices with hooks, variants, and audience intent notes.
Maps each ad unit to a destination page claim for message match.
Flags unsubstantiated claims, risky guarantees, and likely policy issues.
Iterates losing creative while preserving winners and approved wording.
Prepares handoff summaries for later ROAS audit workflows.
limitations: Requires an offer, audience, platform, and destination page or page copy.
Does not launch campaigns or change ad account settings.
Does not replace legal, medical, financial, or platform policy review.
Cannot substantiate claims unless the user provides evidence or an approved claim ledger.

use_cases.title: Draft Search Ads
use_cases.description: Create RSA headlines and descriptions that align with a landing page offer and audience intent.

use_cases.title: Plan Creative Tests
use_cases.description: Turn a product offer into angle groups, hooks, and variants for structured creative testing.

use_cases.title: Improve Weak Variants
use_cases.description: Replace losing headlines while keeping proven winners and documented claim wording intact.

prompt_templates.title: Create First RSA Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate 15 RSA headlines and 4 descriptions for this offer: [offer]. Use this destination page: [URL or pasted page copy]. Audience: [audience]. Platform: Google Search.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Angle Matrix
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for structured creative exploration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 3 by 3 angle matrix for [offer] on [platform]. Include audience intent, hook type, headline direction, and the landing page claim each angle matches.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate Losing Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt using existing performance notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Iterate these losing headlines: [paste headlines]. Keep these winners: [paste winners]. Replace weak variants, preserve message match to [URL or page copy], and flag unsupported claims.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Auditor Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an auditor-ready creative handoff for [offer]. Include final units, message-match notes, claim flags, policy risks, assumptions, open loops, and recommended next skill.

output_examples.input: A B2B SaaS team needs Google Search ad variants for a free trial landing page.
output: A set of RSA headlines and descriptions within Google Search limits.
Message-match notes tied to the free trial, product value, and page CTA.
A short list of claim risks and source needs for review.

output_examples.input: An agency has weak Meta hooks and wants fresh test angles for a client offer.
output: A benefit, pain, proof, and urgency angle matrix with hook options.
Creative notes that separate observed competitor patterns from original copy.
Guidance on which claims need approval before launch.

output_examples.input: A founder pastes losing headlines and asks for replacements without changing the offer.
output: Rewritten variants that keep approved claims and remove vague language.
A winner preservation note and a replacement rationale for each weak unit.
Open loops for missing proof, pricing, or testimonials.

best_practices: Provide the landing page URL or paste the page copy before asking for final ad units.
Share approved claims, prices, guarantees, and restricted terms before creative drafting.
Review flagged claims and policy risks before importing any ad copy into a platform.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent statistics, testimonials, guarantees, or prices.
Do not copy competitor ads directly from transparency libraries.
Do not use the output as a final compliance approval.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates paid ad headlines, descriptions, hooks, angle matrices, and message-match notes.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It can adapt to Google, Meta, and other platforms when you provide the required format and limits.

faq.question: Does it fetch landing pages automatically?
faq.answer: Only if the host environment has browsing access. You can also paste the page copy.

faq.question: Can it save the creative set?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for confirmation before saving a handoff in the project memory folder.

faq.question: Does it audit ad account performance?
faq.answer: No. Use the ad account auditor skill after the creative set is ready.

faq.question: How does it handle unsupported claims?
faq.answer: It flags them, marks source needs, and routes unresolved claims to the offer claims workflow.
